The major difference is that naturalism concerns the underpinning values of international society, while positivism concerns the international rules as such. My earlier answer used the qualitative-research sense of the terms. The team note points to the international-society and international-law sense, and the first option is the one that fits it. The second option, about non-European versus Euro-centric thought, doesn't match how the two terms are normally contrasted.
